executive_preview: The clearest shift this week is toward a more segmented automotive market. Automakers are simultaneously expanding electrification and retreating from EV programs that do not meet demand, pricing, or profitability targets. Volkswagen is discounting remaining ID.4 inventory and delaying the ID.

lead_development.title: EV ownership is creating a broader repair and service ecosystem.
lead_development.what_happened: ZF introduced repair kits for hybrid and EV motors, inverters, transmission mechatronics, and reducers. A documented F-150 Lightning battery replacement also emphasized the need for specialized lifting and high-voltage equipment.
lead_development.why_it_matters: The market is beginning to move beyond an all-or-nothing battery replacement model. Independent repairers and dealers that develop high-voltage capability may capture more post-warranty work, but equipment, training, safety procedures, and parts availability remain barriers.

downside.teaser: Volkswagen's large ID.4 incentives and discontinued production create a visible price gap between new and used vehicles.
